column1: # Stage S9 K0b: the in-place kernel cuts of the API, part two. The Discord OAuth2, guild-member and
# webhook clients move into apps/api/src/kernel/discord/ and the equipment dataset service module into
# apps/api/src/kernel/equipment_datasets/, so that core::application_state names no domain. Whole
# files and the whole dataset folder move here; the membership lookup failure is cut out of the
# REST reconciliation by hand after the moves, the webhook gains its own input type, and the mod
# declarations are edited by hand. Each module prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the API source
# and one `api::` row scoped to the API package (integration tests, binaries, doc examples).
